cards.name: Glitchling Mage

coverage_override.reason: Four independent printed units: the Pendulum-to-Ritual group summon replacement, named Ritual permission, hand reveal/search effect, and Special-Summon-triggered Ritual effect. The helper completion listener is part of the first procedure, not a fifth printed effect.

effects.printed_clause: Pendulum Effect: If you would conduct a Pendulum Summon while you control another Cyberse Pendulum Monster in your Pendulum Zone, you can Ritual Summon any number of Cyberse Ritual Monsters from your hand or face-up Extra Deck with a Level between the Pendulum Scales of the 2 cards in your Pendulum Zones by Tributing Cyberse monsters you control whose total Levels equal or exceed the Levels of the Ritual Monsters.
effects.lua_implementation: The Pendulum Zone now registers an EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC_G procedure with SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL. Its condition is available only while the normal Pendulum Summon opportunity is unused and the other Pendulum Zone holds a Cyberse Pendulum Monster. It selects any legal in-scale Cyberse Ritual group from hand/face-up Extra Deck, validates every chosen controlled Cyberse material against every Ritual Monster, releases materials, marks aux.PendulumChecklist as consumed, merges the Ritual group into the procedure summon group, and completes their summon procedures on success.

official_references.matched_structure: Official custom EFFECT_SPSUMMON_PROC_G implements an alternate Pendulum Summon procedure and consumes aux.PendulumChecklist.
official_references.official_effect_text: If your opponent has 2 cards in their Pendulum Zones: [b]Target[/b] those 2 cards; while both targets are in their Pendulum Zones, [b]you can[/b] Pendulum Summon using their Pendulum Scales this turn, but only from the Extra Deck.

official_references.matched_structure: Official script validates greater-or-equal Ritual material Levels, releases Ritual Materials, uses SUMMON_TYPE_RITUAL, and completes the procedure.

effects.issue: The previous independent Ignition Effect did not replace or consume a Pendulum Summon. Omega's official group summon procedure hook supports the printed replacement, and the Lua now uses it.
effects.required_resolution: None; runtime-regression-test multi-Ritual selection, Extra Deck zones, and material restrictions.
